notes.title: Demo 1.14 - Content Update & Save Support
notes.notes:
Over the past month, we've been refining the demo's puzzle design based on your feedback. The updates on 22 June and today include:

Level Changes

Added 4 brand-new levels, and removed 3 old ones.

Changed the ending of the demo.

Significantly changed 6 levels (core ideas remain the same).

Made small tweaks to 4 other levels.

Refined several hints.

New Feature

The game now saves your progress! (There may still be a few bugs - please let us know if you encounter any.)

Polish & Fixes

Fixed a bug where automatic replay stopped before rings.

Added a "Loading…" message in a specific situation.

You can now close the ending screen by pressing Esc.

Fixed a bug that occurred on Low graphics quality.

Fixed a bug affecting when a level gets marked as solved.

Thanks again for playing and sharing your thoughts - it's a huge help as we continue improving the game!

notes.title: Demo 1.09 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the warm response to our demo launch last week! Here's the first round of fixes based on your feedback.


 Changed input repeat speed when holding down a movement key or undo.
 Changed the axis of camera rotation. You can now also use the middle mouse button to rotate.
 Added a visual indicator showing where a previous solution will be replayed.
 Added a different visual indicator if the door does not open because *that* condition is not satisfied.
 Minor changes to the world, including when certain rooms are revealed.
 Escape popup now has a white background.
 Fixed a crash that occurred after putting the computer in sleep mode.
